I only played the original I Wanna Be The Guy and beat it on Very Hard. Infuriating nostalgia trip, hahaha. I didn't know there were more games in the franchise.

It's not a franchise. It's a wide variety of people making various games better, worse, or even just outright different than/from IWBTG. For example, NANG(as far as I've reached which is ~floor 30 of 100) is a series of small rooms with elevators between stages. It also has text boxes with amusing humor and even is informative about what you need to do sometimes. It's pure needle(which is the platforming) so far, and I think for the entire game, so there's no traps, but then there's games like Heaventrap which are very heavy on the trap aspects where you run into triggers and have to handle whatever comes your way to kill you.(think flying spikes, slightly moving spike positions to screw with your jump or require a double jump where it would otherwise be a single jump, non-button mini-chases, etc.) Also, IIRC IWBTG doesn't have any avoidance bosses. Heck, there's even Color Puzzle where the game is more puzzle than platformer. Just looking at it through the lens of IWBTG limits you way too much. Just go try a bunch and see the kinds you prefer. Personally, I'm the kind of person who just grinds needle and is terrible at bosses and avoidance.
